content.title: Planning a Trip to Lowe's This Easter? Find Out if Stores Will Be Open on Sunday
content.text: Is Lowe's Open or Closed on Easter? What to Know for 2026Whether you're painting the kitchen or shopping for new deck furniture, find out if Lowe's will be open this Sunday.April 4, 2026, 2:00 PM CDTPlanning to shop at Lowe's this Easter? Here's what to know about the home improvement retailer's hours this Sunday.Bloomberg / Getty ImagesCreate your free account or log in to save this articleEaster falls on Sunday, April 5. Whether you plan to celebrate the holiday by gathering with loved ones or you're expecting Peter Cottontail to drop by with baskets for the kids, you may need to head out for a few essentials this weekend. Much like Christmas and Thanksgiving, Easter Sunday is one of the biggest commemorations of the year. Because of that, many businesses, restaurants and stores are closed to give employees the day off to enjoy the April holiday. Among them? Costco, Target, Aldi and a variety of others. But what about Lowe's? If you are working on a home improvement project or need last-minute necessities for Easter brunch, you may be wondering if Lowe's is open on Easter.To help ensure you have everything you need to make this year's Easter celebration a success, TODAY.com reached out to the home-improvement retailer to find out the latest information on whether or not stores will be welcoming customers this Sunday. See below to find out the answer, as well as to learn what other retailers and grocers will be open on April 5. According to a Lowe's spokesperson, stores will be closed on Sunday in observance of the Easter holiday. Doors will reopen on Monday, April 6, during normal business hours. To confirm local Lowe's store hours, check the locator, which you'll find right here. Stores Open on Easter 2026While Lowe's locations will be closed this Easter, see below for a sampling of retailers that will be open on Sunday or find a full list right here. BJ’s Wholesale Club: A majority of BJ’s clubs will be open on Easter Sunday from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. BJ’s recommends confirming local hours before going. Find local hours here.Home Depot: Stores will be open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Hours may vary by location. Find local hours here.IKEA: Most stores will be open from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m. Confirm hours before going. Find local hours here.Kroger: A majority of stores will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here.Menards: Stores will be open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Find local hours here.Trader Joe’s: Stores will be open during regular business hours. Find local hours here.Walmart: Stores will be open during normal business hours. Find local hours here.Whole Foods: Stores will be open until 6 p.m. Find local hours here.
